name: define a deterministic grid expansion as an importable function
definition: author a module exposing a solver callable that folds a small 2x2 input tile into a 6x6 output per the described operating rule (tiling and horizontal/vertical shifting) generally, not per hard-coded input.
failure_mode: a special-case or a wrong tiling direction yields mismatches for the hidden example.

name: delete specific user accounts while preserving all others
definition: Issue delete requests for the targeted accounts only, ensuring non-target accounts remain intact and still authenticate.
failure_mode: Over-deletion removes other accounts, or under-deletion leaves targets alive.
